messages:
Maria: Heads-up — onboarding runtime guide has a broken config link: https://redwood-inference.dev/docs/runtime/config -> 404. link-scan-bot flagged this during the nightly sweep. Anyone owning runtime guide?
link-scan-bot: automated scan result: 1 dead link detected in docs/onboarding/runtime.md (line ~42) -> /docs/runtime/config (HTTP 404).
Aj: I can pick this up unless someone else is already on it. quick patch sounds fine.
Lindsey: thanks Aj. FYI that page was moved in the refactor — the canonical path is /guides/runtime/configuration.
Sanjay: if Aj is doing the PR, here's a quick one-liner you can run locally:
```
rg '/docs/runtime/config' -l docs | xargs -n1 sed -i "s#/docs/runtime/config#/guides/runtime/configuration#g"
git add -A && git commit -m "fix(docs): update runtime config links"
```
(uses ripgrep + sed; test locally first)
Aj: I’ll open a PR in a few minutes. tagging @Lindsey for canonical-path verification :+1:
Lindsey: LGTM — also please add a redirect in redirects.json so old external links don't break (example entry under "staticRedirects").
Aj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — small replace + added redirect entry. request-review @Lindsey @Sanjay
docs-ci: CI for PR #4321 completed — build: pass, linkchecker: 0 failures.
Maria: Awesome, thanks! Assigning short-term ownership: Aj (patch + PR), Lindsey (canonical path / redirects check). Filed tracker ticket RWD-1891 and added a quick note.
